about: Scripture events that no Wayfinder chapter supplies, and notes added to imported events (DESIGN.md section 3, Q15). An annotation's `related` lists world-history ids as written in scripts/history/batch-N.json, without the h- prefix. Its `relatedNote` gives the reason (DESIGN.md section 6).

events.title: Adam blesses his posterity at Adam-ondi-Ahman
events.summary: Three years before he died, Adam gathered his righteous descendants in the valley of Adam-ondi-Ahman. He gave them his last blessing. D&C 116 names Spring Hill, Missouri, as Adam-ondi-Ahman.

genesis-10.placeNote: Babel is shown at Babylon, the traditional site.

genesis-11.placeNote: Babel is shown at Babylon, the traditional site.

isaiah-45.relatedNote: Isaiah 45:1 names Cyrus, the Persian king who later let the exiles return.

nahum-3.relatedNote: Nahum foretells the fall of Nineveh. It fell to the Babylonians and Medes in 612 BCE.

daniel-5.relatedNote: Daniel 5:28 gives Babylon's kingdom to the Medes and Persians. Cyrus founded their empire.

ezra-1.relatedNote: Ezra 1 opens with the decree of Cyrus, king of Persia, ending the exile.

luke-2.relatedNote: Luke 2:1 names the decree of Caesar Augustus that sent Joseph to Bethlehem.

matthew-24.relatedNote: Jesus foretells the temple's fall in Matthew 24:2. Rome destroyed it in 70 CE.

dc-101.relatedNote: In D&C 101:80 the Lord says he established the Constitution of this land.

dc-87.relatedNote: D&C 87 foretells war beginning with the rebellion of South Carolina. The Civil War began there in 1861.
